2_decode_collapses_prefill_barely_moves.reading: Memory-bound decode degrades about 51x while compute-bound prefill degrades about 2.4x. A clock or power collapse would slow both roughly proportionally. Attempt 1 measured the same asymmetry (about 75x decode against about 13x prefill) without the telemetry to attribute it.

3_the_gpu_was_not_throttled_while_it_sta.reading: Throttling WAS observed and is disclosed: the sw_power_cap flag was active on 7 of 122 main-loop samples, at power excursions toward the 100 W cap. It does not explain the stall. Through the stalled regime the SM clock sat at 2,482 MHz median -- against the 2,500 MHz lock ceiling, i.e. NOT reduced -- with median draw 45 W of a 100 W cap, 55 C median, and no hardware or thermal flag ever active, while GPU utilization pinned at 100 percent and decode delivered about 1 token per second. Full clocks, half the power budget, cool, 100 percent busy and no throughput is the signature of a device spinning on memory transfers, not of a clock collapse.

fix_2_precompute.defect: The miss path spawns the sidecar and NEVER STOPS IT. One miss at loop contact about 12 of 208 therefore restored the exact attempt-1 VRAM condition for the whole remaining loop. The precompute removed 91 percent of the in-loop tool contacts and 0 percent of the VRAM contention, because contention is a function of whether the process is RESIDENT, not of how many contacts it serves.
fix_2_precompute.status: WORKED ON ITS OWN TERMS, THEN WAS UNDONE BY ITS OWN FALLBACK
fix_2_precompute.the_one_line_repair: Stop the sidecar immediately after each live embed -- the spawn costs 5.1 s and buys back 2,837 MiB. At the measured 8.6 percent miss rate that is about 9 spawn/stop cycles over 104 samples, about 46 s of added wall time, against a 51x decode collapse. Alternatively defer misses: fly the loop with the sidecar down and an inert query vector is NOT acceptable (it changes what the policy reads), so the correct deferral is a two-pass loop -- pass 1 flies all 104 direct decodes with the sidecar down, then one offline embed pass covers every miss, then pass 2 flies the evidence contacts. That costs 104 extra prompt evaluations and keeps the sidecar out of the GPU loop entirely.
